constraints: All hooks must exit 0 on error (advisory hooks never block the tool call)
PreToolUse hooks have 5s timeout — changes must not add latency
SessionStart hooks have 10s timeout — latency tolerance is higher here
stop_processor.py runs as detached nohup background process — no timeout constraint
om_write.py is imported by stop_processor.py and load-session-context.sh — changes propagate to both callers
profile.sh exports SESSION_ID from CLAUDE_SESSION_ID with PPID fallback — BUG-13 fix scope is guard-protected-files.sh only, do NOT change profile.sh
settings.json is read by Claude Code runtime — invalid JSON breaks the entire session
Existing safe pattern: load-session-context.sh line 36 uses python3 - "$VAR" <<'PYEOF' with sys.argv[1]
fcntl.flock is the agreed lockfile approach per decision-103
3 persistence surfaces per decision-79: epics.db, openmemory.sqlite, run-state.db
